$comment: RoleCall task category — single source of truth for tasks that are NOT attached to a job. On a task row, the chip slot shows either the job (company · pipeline stage) or, when there is no job, the task's category. `id` is the stable machine value; `label` is display text.
$storage: Store as the `id` in a database ENUM column whose allowed values are exactly the `id`s below. Changing this list means editing this file AND running an enum migration.
$appliesWhen: Category is required when `job_id` is null and ignored when a job is attached — the job chip takes the slot. If a job-attached task ever needs a category too, that is a model change, not a display change.
$style: Rendered as an outline pill in the same slot and size as the job chip — no fill, no dot, `--priority-low-border` weight. The lighter treatment is deliberate: it reflects lower urgency without hiding the task. Never tint these with a pipeline color; they have no pipeline stage.

categories.label: Networking
